instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains a closed 24 mm by 12 mm rectangular sketch on the XZ plane with corners at (0, 0), (24, 0), (24, 12), and (0, 12) in sketch coordinates. Use the Part workbench Shape Builder tools to create one planar face from the supplied closed rectangular wire, then use the Part workbench Extrude tool to extrude that face as a solid 8 mm in the positive global Y direction. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
